questions.question: What did the LORD do when David waited patiently?
options: Sent down fire from heaven to consume all of his enemies
Inclined to him, heard his cry, and drew him up from the pit
Opened up the heavens and poured down the cool refreshing rain
Raised up a great army to go out and fight on his behalf
questions.answer: Inclined to him, heard his cry, and drew him up from the pit

questions.question: What did God put in David's mouth?
options: A solemn vow, a binding oath
A quiet prayer, a whispered plea
A new song, a song of praise
A bitter cry, a lament of grief
questions.answer: A new song, a song of praise

questions.question: David delights to do God's will, and God's law is within his heart.
